summary: All lookup plugins Ansible finds are enabled. Custom ones go in a lookup_plugins directory next to the play, in a collection's plugins/lookup/, inside a standalone role, or in a configured lookup path.
questions: Where do I put a custom lookup plugin?
Do I have to enable lookup plugins in ansible.cfg?
Where do lookup plugins live inside a collection?

answer_card.title: Enabling custom lookup plugins
answer_card.answer_md:
All discovered lookups are enabled. Put custom ones in:
- `lookup_plugins/` next to your play
- `plugins/lookup/` in an installed collection
- a standalone role
- a lookup directory configured in `ansible.cfg`
